title: relationship_check input
description: Provider service call before issuing an access token: the current authoritative decision, bound to this request's nonce, participants, versions and capabilities. Not a reusable authorization.

request_nonce.description: A fresh random value; the decision echoes it.

capability_ids.description: Capability references: <capability_id>:<major>, as in the assertion's caps and the token scopes, for example cap_invoice_extract:2. A bare <capability_id> means the major version currently listed.

collaboration_id.description: Optional engagement the call belongs to.

provider_agent_id.description: Optional. The provider is the authenticated caller; when sent, this must name it.

session_kind.description: Optional: trial or validation for platform sessions; their connection IDs carry a trial_ or valcon_ prefix, so it can be left out.

trial_session_id.description: Optional: the trial session, for session_kind trial.
